1. Night Trax is a 6 column, 4 rows slot with 72 paylines.
2. The game offers several bet levels for each currency.
3. Each bet is 100 coins.
4. A game round starts on the selected bet level when the player hits the Spin button.
5. The game can be played automatically by activating Auto Spin (if available in the applicable jurisdiction). Hold down the Spin button or use the Auto Spin button to set the number of game rounds to be played automatically.
6. Winnings and winning combinations are paid out according to the Paytable.
7. Winnings are presented in the player's currency or in coins. The player can change preference in Settings.
8. Night Trax is played in two modes; Normal mode and Bonus mode with free spins.
9. The wild symbol substitutes for any symbol on a connecting payline, except the bonus symbol. A payline of all wilds pays as the highest value symbol.
10. A payline can start anywhere on the reels. It is counted for from left to right but doesn't have to start or end at the first or sixth reel.
11. A payline can either be horizontal or diagonal.
12. A diagonal payline consists of diagonal arrow symbols, which connect with arrows of same colour through their endpoints in multiple directions.
13. A payline triggers the Trax Respin feature, which will respin all non-winning symbols, and continue to deliver additional respins until there are no more extended paylines or new wins. Winnings are paid out once the respins are completed.
14. A payline containing diagonal arrows can split into 2 or more branches, and create separate paylines with subsequent splits. A split can occur up to 5 times on the initial payline. Each split on a payline adds a multiplier to the win amount for the payline. Following multipliers can be added: x2, x4, x8, x16 and x32.
15. Bonus Symbols are sticky during Trax Respins, but they do not trigger respins.
16. 3 bonus symbols anywhere in game view during Normal mode trigger Bonus mode. The Bonus mode will start once all Trax Respins are completed.
17. The 3 bonus symbols will lock in position, and in the beginning of the bonus game they will turn into randomised sticky multipliers and be collected in a multiplier counter.
18. The multiplier bonus game starts with 3 free spins, and contains multipliers, upgrading multiplier arrows and blanks. Every multiplier which spins in will lock in position, and also reset the free spins counter back to 3 free spins. As winnings, the multipliers will be collected and multiplied with the bet amount.
19. The upgrading multiplier symbol exists as a horisontal arrow pointing right. The upgrading multiplier arrows connect multipliers, and upgrade themselves with the starting multiplier value from the left, and also adds the same multiplier value onto the multiplier to the right. Several upgrading multiplier symbols can create a connection between 2 multipliers.
20. If the Multiplier bonus board gets full of multipliers, it will summarize all landed multipliers, and restart the free spins counter. The free spins counter will then start a countdown, and add the initially collected amount of multipliers to the multiplier counter one time for each counted down free spin.
21. The Multiplier bonus game ends when no free spins remain or when the maximum win has been reached.
22. Winnings are paid out at the end of the bonus game.
23. No bets can be changed during an ongoing spin or in Bonus mode.
24. The theoretical payout (RTP) in Night Trax is 95.0%.
25. The game has a maximum win of 10 000x the placed bet.
26. In the event of malfunction all bets and wins are void.

The X-iter feature offers several different game modes.
X-iter 1: Guarantees a winning game round at the cost of 5x the selected bet.
X-iter 2: Guarantees 3 spins with at least one wild symbol at the cost of 25x the selected bet.
X-iter 3: Guarantees a game round with entry to the bonus game at the cost of 100x the selected bet.
X-iter 4: Guarantees 3 spins with only diagonal arrow symbols, which increases the probability of splits at a cost of 250x the selected bet.
X-iter 5: Guarantees a game round with entry to the Super Bonus game with higher multipliers at the cost of 500x the selected bet.
The X-iter features can only be activated in the base game.
The theoretical payout (RTP) for all X-iter game modes in Night Trax is 95.0%.
All game rules apply for the X-iter features as well.
